# te-drift-detector

> Experimental lexical feature-delta telemetry for multi-turn text. It reports
> baseline-relative feature changes and hand-set threshold crossings for human
> inspection. It does not establish malicious drift, model compromise,
> calibrated confidence, or safety severity.

## Install

    pip install git+https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/te-drift-detector  # not yet on PyPI

## CLI

    te-drift detect --attack-type poisoning      # built-in synthetic conversation
    te-drift detect --attack-type normal
    te-drift session --session-jsonl PATH        # user/assistant JSONL records
    te-drift session --session-jsonl PATH --mode sliding-window --window-size 10
    te-drift eval                                # demo/self-check fixtures

## Python

    from te_drift import TEDriftDetector
    report = TEDriftDetector().run_conversation([(role, text), ...])
    report["threat_level"]        # legacy uncalibrated heuristic tier name
    report["anomalies_detected"]  # number of heuristic rule crossings

    from te_drift import load_turns, run_drift_analysis
    from te_drift.evals import run_all

## Evidence boundary

The package extracts eight lexical feature groups and compares them with a
first-turn baseline. Its fields named `confidence` and `threat_level` are
uncalibrated rule scores and heuristic tiers, not safety severity. The bundled
synthetic sequences are authored and scored by this repository; they are
demo/self-check fixtures, not evidence of effectiveness or generalization.
Detection efficacy, threshold calibration, and recovery benefit remain unproved.

The JSONL adapter observes user and assistant records. It is not a general
system/scaffold state reader. The field named `velocity_drift` is change in the
scalar distance from baseline, not direct distance from the previous fingerprint.

## Network behavior

The default lexical path stays in-process. Setting `TE_DRIFT_EMBED=1` can make
an optional configured network call to `TE_DRIFT_OLLAMA_URL` and transmit the
analyzed text. If the endpoint is unavailable, errors, or supplies no vector,
the implementation silently falls back to lexical set overlap. The report does
not expose the fallback. Embedding quality has not been evaluated.

## Limits

Meaning-preserving changes can produce small deltas, and benign wording changes
can produce large ones. Treat every crossing as a prompt for human inspection.
The tool does not establish malicious drift, and its output is not safety
severity. Do not enable optional networking for sensitive text without
reviewing and trusting the configured endpoint.
